title: First-run interactive tile set + compact validator walkthrough for structured output
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design a set of compact, interactive tiles and an inline validator walkthrough for users who encounter structured output (JSON payloads) during first-run onboarding. Deliverables include: a tile library (three density variants), animated micro-interactions for validation feedback, a mini-playground screenshot flow for docs, and authoring guidance for product to ensure parity across hosted and private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Three tile density variants (compact, default, spacious) with annotated specs ready for engineering
Interactive validator states: valid, warning (soft validation), error (schema mismatch), and suggested-fix overlay
Two doc-ready screenshot flows: "Quick example" and "Edge case debugging" with copy-ready microcopy
Figma file with developer handoff tokens and exported PNG/SVG assets in 1x and 2x
Accessibility checklist (color contrast, keyboard focus, screen reader labels) attached
Signed off by PM and one backend engineer (to validate feasibility)
updates: 2026-03-05: Ticket created after weekly design sync. PM asked for more emphasis on error recovery UX rather than only highlighting schema errors.

2026-03-07: Low-fidelity tiles reviewed with Eng (Sasha Liu). Eng flagged concern about heavy DOM for animated list diffs; agreed to prefer CSS transitions and request backend provide minimal change-diff payloads.

2026-03-09: Iteration v2 added 'suggested fix' overlay that maps an input error to a one-click fix example. Prototype demoed in Figma; PM (Liam O'Connor) requested a softer warning style for non-critical mismatches.
2026-03-11: Accessibility pass completed by DesignOps (contrast adjustments and keyboard-only walkthrough). Added aria-live regions for streaming validation messages.
2026-03-12: Handoff package exported; engineering PR stubbed: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4127 (design assets + storybook stories).
2026-03-13: Design review scheduled; waiting on backend feasibility sign-off for suggested-fix telemetry events.
review_feedback: PM Liam O'Connor: 'Love the single-click suggested fix but ensure we don't mask underlying schema mismatch for audit compliance. Add an 'explain' link that expands the raw schema error.'
Eng Sasha Liu: 'Prefer server to send 'corrections' array to avoid client-side heuristics. We'll add an API field recommended in the spec doc.'
Security (Priya Menon): 'Audit log requirements: when a user applies a suggested fix, emit a non-redactable event. Add copy in the interaction modal to surface this.'
DesignOps Raul Mendes: 'Increase hit target for touch, and include a high-contrast variant for low-vision users. Validate with VoiceOver and TalkBack.'
